profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Thermo Fisher Scientific
profile.summary:
I am a passionate software developer with strong experience in delivering cutting edge mobile and web applications. I am passionate about learning new technologies and adopting innovative approaches for excellent user experience.
I have over 14 years of experience in software development, testing, and project management. I am currently working as Senior Software Engineer for Thermo Fisher Scientific where we develop high quality LIMS applications which plays vital role in any lab and research organization globally. 
I have strong experience in working with global teams and engaging with sales, services, and product owners to understand customer usability and requirements.
In fast changing technical environment, got opportunity to work on different platforms and technologies to bring bottoms-up innovation in mobile, web and in mixed reality applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Web & Cloud Application Development
•	Led the design and development of secure, scalable web applications using C# .NET Core, Blazor, JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
•	Designed and implemented RESTful APIs supporting web and mobile clients, ensuring performance, scalability, and security.
•	Contributed to application architecture and design decisions, delivering prototypes and technical solutions to stakeholders.
•	Implemented OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect SSO, enabling secure authentication and authorization across enterprise systems.
•	Integrated Docker-based CI/CD pipelines, automating builds, testing, and deployments.
•	Performed security audits and vulnerability remediation using CodeQL and JFrog, improving overall application security posture.
•	Collaborated with QA and engineering teams to implement automated testing, reducing regressions and accelerating release cycles.
•	Explored and integrated AI-driven capabilities to enhance application functionality and user experience.

Mobile Application Development
•	Led development of cross-platform mobile applications for iOS, Android, and UWP using Xamarin and .NET Standard.
•	Designed mobile application architecture using MVVM (Prism, DryIoc) and reusable UI components.
•	Developed and maintained backend APIs and Postman-based API validation suites to ensure reliability and robustness.
•	Built a voice-enabled mobile assistant using TensorFlow Lite, achieving over 90% accuracy in noisy environments through model optimization and signal filtering.
•	Integrated Azure Cognitive Services to enable speech-to-text and intelligent in-app automation.
•	Managed CI/CD pipelines (Azure Pipelines) and app store releases for iOS, Android, and UWP platforms.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
-	Design and developed high performing and scalable cross platform mobile applications on the Apache Cordova platform.
-	Developed responsive applications using HTML5, CSS, and JavaScript.
-	Oversaw all support incident queries from support team.
-       Involved in making user stories by analyzing the requirement and creating tasks to be completed in the sprint.

positions.title: Sr. Software Testing Engineer
positions.description:
-	Design and developed automation testing in Team foundation server.
-	Manage an application database on oracle including configuration, installation, administration and troubleshoot Oracle database systems and tools.
-	Analyze and design of databases and user interfaces.
-	Build and maintain SQL scripts, indexes, and complex queries for data analysis and extraction
-	Analyze the product requirement document and prepare test plan for SAP\LIMS interface product.
-	Prepare and execute test cases, functional testing, integration, and regression testing to cover the functional requirements of the product in HP Quality center.

positions.title: Sr. QA and Testing specialist
positions.description:
-	Design, develop and implement Access - VBA applications.
-	Interact with project manager and stake holders to gather requirement and enhancements.
-	Maintain application database back-up and assure continuity of the application.
-	Develop, maintain and troubleshoot SQL Server database and application code.
-	Provide day-to-day management of project with regular status report, running and documenting project review meeting.
-	Co-ordinate and ensure smooth transition of new applications and technology.
-	Create test plan and conduct assessment meeting to identify the risks associated with the project.
-	Analyze requirements for projects and develop detailed comprehensive plan.
-	Worked closely with Project Managers, Product Owners, Developers, S/W Packaging & Distribution and Release Implementation teams. 
-	Ensures all testing activities is captured, stored, and signed off by all stakeholders and prepare final sign off report. 
-	Implement, configure, and troubleshoot web-based applications.

educations.schoolName: Shree Ramdeo Baba Kamla Nehru Engineering College
